Population increased in North Lincolnshire

The estimated population of North Lincolnshire in 2024 was 171,336 usual residents, a rise of 0.5% since 2023.

This meant that North Lincolnshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North Lincolnshire increased by 0.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, North Lincolnshire was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North Lincolnshire

The average (median) age stayed at 44.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North Lincolnshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North Lincolnshire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North Lincolnshire's population of 171,336 usual residents was made up of:

  • 30,501 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.8%)
  • 101,569 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.3%)
  • 39,266 people aged 65 years and over, (22.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North Lincolnshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North Lincolnshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North Lincolnshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North Lincolnshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 444 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 1,469 births and 1,913 deaths in North Lincolnshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 997 (0.6%). There were 6,603 people entering the area and 5,606 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North Lincolnshire's population of 325 (0.2%) as a result of 1,100 people entering the area and 775 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North Lincolnshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North Lincolnshire in mid-2023 is 170,477.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 250 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 140 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 390 people.
